problem_statement: parse_duration('5m') returns 5 instead of 300: minutes are treated as seconds.
test_patch:
--- a/tests/test_timekit_duration.py
+++ b/tests/test_timekit_duration.py
@@ -11,3 +11,11 @@
 
 def test_empty_is_zero():
     assert parse_duration("") == 0
+
+
+def test_minutes():
+    assert parse_duration("5m") == 300
+
+
+def test_hours_and_minutes():
+    assert parse_duration("1h30m") == 5400
